title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: An agent run makes four model calls. The first call reads 1,000 tokens of context, and each tool step before the next call adds 500 tokens, which the program re-sends on every later call. How many input tokens are billed in total across the four calls?

On Monday a student chats with your assistant and mentions that they are building a kayak rack. On Tuesday they open a new session. The assistant has no saved notes. What does the model have available at the start of Tuesday's run?

options.text: A short summary of Monday that the model keeps in its own weights
Monday's full transcript, because the context window carries over days
Only the instructions, tool descriptions and the student's new message
Monday's key facts, since the model learns from each conversation

items.stem: The program has saved the note "Priya: laser training passed 2 March" in a file. Priya starts a new session and asks to book the laser cutter. How does the model come to use that note?

options.text: The model opens the file on its own and reads the note directly
The program reads the file and places its text in the context
The model recognizes Priya from earlier chats and recalls the note
The note was stored inside the model after the earlier session

items.stem: At step 2, a tool returned a 30,000-token page dump. The agent has finished using it, but the run has ten more steps. Which change keeps the remaining calls cheapest without losing what the agent needs?

options.text: Switch to a model with a larger context window for the later steps
Add the page dump to the system prompt so that it is cached
Tell the model in the prompt to answer briefly from here onward
Replace the dump with a two-line note of what it contained

items.stem: A student asks for "laser power for 3 mm acrylic". Keyword search over the manual misses the chunk titled "Cutting parameters" that holds the answer. Which change addresses this failure most directly?

options.text: Add search by meaning (embeddings) alongside the keyword search
Raise the context window limit so more chunks can be included
Shorten the system prompt so the search has more room to work
Have the model guess a page number and fetch that page directly
